abstract: A case of mucinous cystadenoma of the testis in a 55-year-old man is reported. The tumor was confined to the testis and was clearly separated from the epididymis. There was no connection between the tumor cyst and the rete testis. The lumen of the cyst was lined with a single-layer of columnar cells interspersed with goblet cells. There was neither stromal invasion nor metastasis to other organs and there were no ovarian or germ cell neoplastic elements in the tumor. Immunohistochemical analysis revealed that MUC2, MUC5AC, carcinoembryonic antigen, CA19-9, CK7 and CK20 proteins were expressed on the tumor epithelial cells, whereas expression of MUC6, alpha-fetoprotein, CA125, human chorionic gonadotrophin, estrogen receptor, progesterone receptor, calretinin, chromogranin A, p53, cyclin D1 and bcl-2 proteins was absent. Ki-67 protein was weakly and sparsely expressed in the nuclei of epithelial cells. The mucinous cystadenoma in the present case, which was devoid of a connection to testicular appendices and had the immunohistochemical characteristics of gastrointestinal mucosa, might have originated from one-sided differentiation of teratoma cells.
abstract_ja: 55歳男性の精巣粘液性嚢胞腺腫の症例を報告する。腫瘍は精巣内に限局し、精巣付属器とは明瞭に分離していた。嚢胞内腔と精巣網の間に連続性はなかった。嚢胞内腔は、杯細胞を散在させた単層円柱上皮で覆われていた。間質浸潤や他臓器への転移はなく、卵巣または胚細胞性腫瘍成分は認められなかった。免疫組織化学的検討では、腫瘍上皮細胞にMUC2、MUC5AC、癌胎児性抗原、CA19-9、CK7、CK20が発現していた。一方、MUC6、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、CA125、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン、エストロゲン受容体、プロゲステロン受容体、カルレチニン、クロモグラニンA、p53、サイクリンD1、bcl-2は発現していなかった。Ki-67は核内に弱く、少数に発現していた。本症例の粘液性嚢胞腺腫は精巣付属器との連続性がなく、消化管粘膜の免疫組織化学的特徴を示した。これは奇形腫細胞の片側分化に由来する可能性がある。
